text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and even making decisions. At its core, AI relies on machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. A more advanced form, called deep learning, uses neural networks inspired by the human brain to process vast amounts of information and improve over time. You already encounter AI every day. Voice assistants like Siri answer your questions, streaming services recommend movies you might enjoy, and navigation apps suggest the fastest route home. Even spam filters in your email use AI to keep unwanted messages away. As technology improves, AI will likely become even more integrated into our daily routines, helping us work, learn, and live more efficiently.
